topology_reasoning: The image is a compact two-level photonic routing structure with two long U-shaped waveguides and a straight central bus. The upper and lower routed guides each have a long parallel coupling section populated by repeated transverse rectangular teeth (a periodic grating/coupling region), then taper to pointed ports at opposite ends. The center bus is a separate straight rectangular guide between the two periodic sections. I model the three conductors with gf.Path/extrude and rectangle primitives, and model each periodic tooth as a rectangle placed along the coupling sections. Function-defining knobs are guide width, bend radius, taper length, coupling-section length, tooth pitch/width, tooth depth, and the vertical separations/offsets between the routed guides and center bus.
